digest.component_or_area: Jira DC harness test helpers / reconciler output contract
propositions: Two live DC harness cells assert on OK: stdout line but canonical sync route deliberately suppresses OK: output per documented contract; both assertions are stale.
Helper _assert_converged_writing_pass must assert BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr instead of OK: on stdout to detect route convergence correctly.

Helper _assert_wrote_nothing must assert BRIDGE_STATE: converged plus both RECON differ totals equal 0 plus zero RECON: batch_outcome lines to prove idempotent zero-write pass, since converged alone does not distinguish writes from no-writes.
Bridge output parsing logic must move into dependency-free _bridge_output.py module to enable unit-lane test coverage independent of live Jira credentials or network.
